description: retro cleanup: pin the name-required messages of agro harness and agro tool, and remove the shell rename leftovers in escalate.sh and banner.sh behind a guard test.

userStories.title: Add the guard tests
userStories.description: As the operator, I want tests that pin the name-required messages and that reject doubled shell defaults. A later edit then cannot change those messages or bring back a rename leftover unseen.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/harness.test.ts` asserts that `parseHarnessArgs(["install"])` returns the error `agro harness install: a harness name is required`.

`.agro/cli/src/__tests__/tool.test.ts` asserts that `parseToolArgs(["install"])` returns the error `agro tool install: a tool name is required`, and that `parseToolArgs(["uninstall"])` returns the error `agro tool uninstall: a tool name is required`.

`.agro/scripts/__tests__/shell-rename-leftovers.test.ts` scans each tracked `.sh` file. The test fails for a parameter expansion of the form `${NAME:-${NAME:-...}}` with the same name twice. The test also fails for a condition of the form `[ ! -d "X" ] && [ -d "X" ]` with the same path twice.
Before US-002, `pnpm exec vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/shell-rename-leftovers.test.ts` exits 1 and names `.agro/skills/escalate/scripts/escalate.sh` and `.agro/install/banner.sh`.

userStories.title: Remove the shell rename leftovers
userStories.description: As the operator, I want each shell default written one time. The scripts then state the behavior that they run.
acceptanceCriteria: Line 4 of `.agro/skills/escalate/scripts/escalate.sh` reads `AGRO_PROJECT_ROOT` one time and keeps the fallback to the path four levels above the script.
`escalate.sh` sets `STATE_DIR` to `ESCALATE_STATE_DIR` when that variable is not empty, and to `$HOME/.agro/escalate` otherwise. The `elif` branch is gone.
`.agro/install/banner.sh` sets `cli_bin` from `AGRO_BIN` with the default `agro`, and reads `AGRO_BIN` one time.

userStories.title: Record manual review evidence
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want the red and green test runs and the script diffs in one file.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/retro-cleanup/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the red run of US-001, the green run after US-002, and the full test suite result.
The PR `## Manual review` section gives the commands and one failure path with its observed exit status.
